Hello! Willikomen!

My name is Adhiraj. I am a math student. I am currently teaching myself introductory abstract algebra and ordinary differential equations. I enjoy studying mathematics.

Apart from mathematics, I like reading fiction books. Currently I am reading Moby Dick by Herman Meville and the Brothers Karamazov by Fyodor Dostoevesky. A couple of books I would recommend are The Martian by Andy Weir, Animal Farm by George Orwell and Man's Search for Meaning by Dr Viktor Frankl. From the very few movies I have watched, I would recommend The Pursuit of Happyness and My Octopus Teacher.
